To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, David Singh <david.singh@oxbridgemed.com>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@oxbridgemed.com>

Subject: Ask: Oxbridge Medical — exception request for premium support / custom EHR connector

Team — looping you in on Oxbridge (attached SOW + pricing). Short ask: Oxbridge wants Premium Support included in year one and a custom Epic connector built as part of the onboarding bundle. The quoted commitment is $480k ARR (36-month term requested by the customer), but procurement is pushing hard on TCO and wants the onboarding fees waived and Premium Support included at no additional charge for year one.

Why this matters: Oxbridge is a regional chain (9 hospitals) and a strategic reference in the NE. If we concede onboarding and support now they’re likely to expand our footprint and push a fast pilot. Financials: list price for onboarding + custom connector = $67,500, Premium Support (first year) list = $60,000. Concession request: waive the $67.5k pro‑serv fee and include Premium Support for year one (effectively ~28% discount to first-year cash).

Attachments: SOW_OXM_v3.pdf, price_sheet_2027.xlsx, oxbridge-security-qa.pdf

Irene — can we get an exec exception to standard PS billing and to include Premium in-year one? I recommend we: (1) require a 14‑month minimum term, (2) add a milestone-based SOW with acceptance criteria, and (3) cap the concession to year one only.

Next steps requested: approval / denial / counter proposal by EOD Thursday 9/16 so procurement can circulate final DocuSign. Happy to jump on a 20-min call.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts

Irene — thanks, quick answers below and attached a redlined SOW and updated pricing workbook.

- ARR impact: Contracted ARR if signed as-is is $480,000 ARR. Waiving PS ($67,500) is a one-time cash concession; including Premium Support year one (list $60k) reduces first-year gross margin by ~12 points but we retain full ARR ($480k) recognized over term. The attached price_sheet_2027.xlsx includes a 36-month revenue waterfall and cashflow.
- Connector scope: initial request is for a single Epic instance + one FHIR interface and one batch ETL for legacy reports — estimated 220 hours of PS work (SOW v3 shows milestones).
- Security: oxbridge-security-qa.pdf is standard; they request syslog forwarding and quarterly audits (no new encryption demands). Legal redline requested a two-week acceptance window — we set milestone acceptance.
- Legal/Finance: please include legal@redwood.com and finance-ops@redwood.com if approved.

Proposed concession (Neha proposed):
1) Waive onboarding professional services fees ($67,500) as a one-time concession,
2) Include Premium Support (Silver tier) for year one only,
3) Require 14-month minimum term or full payment of year one if they cancel before month 14,
4) Add SOW milestone-based acceptance and success criteria.

Business justification (for exec note): Oxbridge is strategically valuable as a northeast hospital system with potential to expand into adjacent clinics. Reference wins with similar footprint have added +2-3x ARR in year two post-implementation. This concession reduces friction in procurement and accelerates go-live.

Attachments: SOW_OXM_v3.pdf (redline), price_sheet_2027.xlsx (impact), oxbridge-security-qa.pdf

Happy to hop on with legal/finance for final language.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
